Analysis revealed that mobservice2 completed processing without proper error handling, leaving data in an inconsistent state. The service's monitoring system failed to detect the abnormal termination, delaying containment. We recommend implementing additional checkpoints and error handling in mobservice2 to prevent similar incidents.
